name: anova
notes: MathTS returns fStatistic/dfBetween/dfWithin; mathjs returns F/dfBetween/dfWithin. MSW=0 edge case differs slightly.

name: betaDist
notes: MathTS dist-objects adds quantile and sample methods; mathjs returns icdf instead of quantile.

name: binomialDist
notes: MathTS uses regularized incomplete beta for CDF and adds quantile/sample; mathjs uses direct summation for CDF.

name: chiSquareTest
notes: MathTS only supports 1D goodness-of-fit; mathjs also supports 2D contingency table independence test.

name: chiSquaredDist
notes: MathTS adds quantile and sample methods; mathjs returns only pdf/cdf/mean/variance.

name: covariance
notes: No covariance function found in MathTS files; only correlation is present in statistics.ts.

name: exponentialDist
notes: MathTS adds sample method and uses quantile instead of icdf naming.

name: fDist
notes: MathTS adds quantile/sample methods; uses bisection for quantile; mathjs has no quantile.

name: gammaDist
notes: MathTS adds quantile/sample; parameter named rate vs beta but same semantics.

name: histogram
notes: No histogram function found in any MathTS file provided.

name: kolmogorovSmirnovTest
notes: MathTS only supports one-sample test with CDF function; two-sample variant is missing. p-value formula differs.

name: kurtosis
notes: No kurtosis function found in any MathTS file provided.

name: linreg
notes: No linreg function found in any MathTS file provided.

name: logNormalDist
notes: MathTS adds quantile/sample methods; uses quantile instead of icdf naming.

name: mannWhitneyTest
notes: MathTS returns uStatistic; mathjs returns U. MathTS lacks tie correction in variance; mathjs includes it.

name: movingAverage
notes: No movingAverage function found in any MathTS file provided.

name: normalDist
notes: MathTS adds sample method and uses quantile instead of icdf naming.

name: poissonDist
notes: MathTS distributions.ts has poissonPMF only; dist-objects.ts is truncated but likely has full object.

name: principalComponentAnalysis
notes: MathTS returns components/explained/scores; mathjs returns components/eigenvalues/scores/explainedVariance.

name: shapiroWilkTest
notes: MathTS uses Blom's approximation for all n; mathjs uses exact tabulated coefficients for n<=11.

name: skewness
notes: No skewness function found in any MathTS file provided.

name: studentTTest
notes: MathTS supports one-sample test (vs mu=0); mathjs only supports two-sample. Return field named statistic vs t.
